reading.title: Void Moon, Stationing Mercury
overview: The Sun at 1° Scorpio conjoins retrograde Venus while squaring Pluto, with Mercury stationing direct in Scorpio and the Moon void of course in Aries until 26 October. Neptune remains sextile Pluto and Uranus trine Pluto, while Saturn conjoins Neptune in Aries. These configurations point to slow structural shifts in collective values and power, with limited forward motion until the Moon enters Taurus.

Mundane tradition associates a void Moon with intervals when new initiatives lack traction and events drift. The Sun-Venus conjunction in Scorpio suggests emphasis on shared resources or alliances under strain, while the outer-planet aspects indicate gradual changes in what societies accept as legitimate authority. Mars in Leo trine Saturn offers endurance in established positions but little breakthrough.

The last New Moon at 17° Libra fell in the 11th house for the United States and the 6th for Russia, Ukraine, Israel and Iran, framing legislative or military-service themes. No major ingresses occur until Venus enters Libra on 25 October.

nations.reading: Transiting Neptune opposes the Sibly MC while Saturn sextiles natal Uranus. These contacts coincide with reported US statements on mediation and travel advisories, yet the fair-test records show no reliable link between such aspects and measurable security events.

Neptune squares the natal Sun and Mars conjoins the ASC. The pattern aligns with ongoing reports of infrastructure strikes, though the same aspects have historically produced outcomes no better than chance against daily loss figures.

Pluto conjoins natal Saturn and Neptune sextiles it. Current aid-delivery and mediation headlines sit within the 6th-house New Moon emphasis on armed forces, but records indicate these transits do not forecast alarm rates above baseline.

Pluto opposes natal Moon and Jupiter squares the natal Sun. Eviction and festival reports appear under the same 6th-house lunation, yet the long-term test finds Mars and lunar aspects add no predictive edge for rocket alerts.

reading.lore_and_intel: Neptune-Pluto and Uranus-Pluto aspects overlap with reports of neighbourhood clearances, aid pauses and Hormuz traffic, while Sun-Venus and Mercury-Jupiter contacts touch festival and mediation items; the same aspects show no statistical edge over chance when tested against daily security metrics across thousands of days.

reading.the_test: Records covering 1,670 to 9,757 days show Mars afflictions, full moons and eclipses produce no better than chance results for air-raid counts, personnel losses or magnitude-6+ earthquakes. The tested margins range from -5 % to +35 % with p-values above 0.13 after correction.
